posts.text:
Last Thursday, June 11, President Trump rolled back protections and expanded industrial fishing access to portions of three marine national monuments in the Pacific Ocean, making it so that all 5 U.S. marine national monuments are no longer protected. 

The conservation movement needs a new approach, one that offers more than spatial targets and lines on maps. ampr.gs/4glAKlt
